senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. נתח, נתק)to cut, reduce, smelt. [Tosef. Shebi. III, 19 לתוך, יתוך Var. ed. Zuck., v. נָתַק.]

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 12:6">Zeb. XII, 6</cite> <he>נ׳ הבשר</he> if the flesh in the fire is burned to hard lumps; <cite ref="Zevachim 106a:6">ib. 106ᵃ</cite>, contrad. to <he>נעשין אפר</he>; v. <cite ref="H01625"><he>חֲרוֹכָא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 15:7">Ex. R. s. 15</cite> <he>של כסף … הִתִּיכָן וכ׳</he> the idols of silver …, he caused to melt and be shapeless as before they were cast. Y. Sabb. X, 10ᵇ bot. <he>המַתִּיךְ אבר</he> he who casts lead (on the Sabbath).

<cite ref="Nazir 50b:3">Naz. 50ᵇ</cite> <he>והִתִּיכוֹ</he> and he melted it (the fat); <cite ref="Tosefta Ohalot 4:3">Tosef. Ohol. IV, 3</cite> <he>וחיתכו</he>, <he>וחתכו</he> (corr. acc.); Y. Naz. VII, 56ᵇ bot. Y. Ab. Zar. III, 43ᵇ; ib. IV, 44ᵇ top <he>המתיך כוס לע״ז</he> he who casts a cup for an idol.—[<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 31:1">Pesik. R. s. 31</cite> <he>מנתכי׳ אחוריה</he>, read: <he>מכופתים לאחוריהם</he>; v. ed. Fr. note 49.]

senses.gloss: to be molten; to be reduced to slags.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Meilah 2:3">Meïl. II, 3</cite> (<cite ref="Meilah 9a:20">9ᵃ</cite>) <he>עד שיוּתַּךְ הבשר</he> (Talm. ed. <he>שיתיך</he>, corr. acc.) until the flesh is charred in small lumps; <cite ref="Zevachim 35b">Zeb. 35ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Zevachim 104b:1">104ᵇ</cite>.—Part. <he>מוּתָּךְ</he>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 21a">Sabb. 21ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>חלב מ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>מְהוּתָּךְ</he>, v. <cite ref="E00949"><he>התך</he></cite>) molten fat.
